cc:Work.dc:title: Box - ClosedBox
cc:Work.dc:description:
Fully closed box
This box is more of a building block than a finished item. Use a vector graphics program (like Inkscape) to add holes or adjust the base plate.
See BasedBox for variant with a base.
Created with Boxes.py (https://boxes.hackerspace-bamberg.de/) Command line: boxes ClosedBox --x 120 --y 90 --h 70 --thickness 3 --outside 0 --reference 0 --labels 0 Command line short: boxes ClosedBox --x --y --h --outside --reference --labels
